title: &bChronofall
subtitle: Pieces of a future the eclipse broke loose. Something fell through the hole where the sun was.

quests.title: &bSomething Fell Through
quests.subtitle: A streak of fire where the sun used to be.
description: &6The Keeper&r
&f&o"I have watched the hole where the sun was for longer than you have been ash. Nothing ever came out of it. Tonight something did."&r

Some nights a &6Chrono Rift&r tears open in the sky and a &6Chrono Pod&r falls through it in a streak of fire: a piece of a future that the Eclipse broke loose. Every minute of night each Ashborn has a small chance of one (one in twenty-five, never more than one in fifteen minutes). It opens 24 to 48 blocks away, and word of which way to look reaches you.
The pod digs a scorched crater. In it stands a &6Rift Cache&r, and around it two or three &cSentinels&r.
&7Find a crash site and right-click the Rift Cache for its &6Rift Shards&7.

quests.title: Eyes in the Crater
quests.subtitle: They guard a morning that never came.
description: &cSentinels&r keep their distance and shoot laser bolts (5 damage a hit). Thirty health, a little armour, visors that glow in the dark. They are not Remnants: nothing in them was ever alive, so nothing in them comes back. Close the distance, or bring a shield.
They drop &6Scrap&r, and sometimes a Rift Shard.
&7Destroy three Sentinels.

quests.title: Salvage
quests.subtitle: Somebody's tomorrow, in pieces.
description: Everything in a Rift Cache is salvage from a year that never came: &6Scrap&r, ingots of metals no smith of the Crown ever named, copper wiring, blank circuit boards, now and then a whole Processor.

The rifts have been falling longer than anyone watched. The deep rock below Y 0 is full of &6Scrap Debris&r: smelt it for scrap (an Electric Furnace from the Ashen Works does it twice as fast). Nine scrap pack into a Block of Scrap.
&7Gather sixteen Scrap.

quests.title: Filed Under Never
quests.subtitle: How do you catalogue a thing that never happened?
description: &o"I collect befores, Ashborn. Every ruin has one. These have none. Nobody built them and nobody ever will: they are afters, from a morning that never came because the sun went out the night before. Show me a few. I need to know which shelf a thing like that goes on."&r &7— Oren, the Archivist&r
&7Show the Archivist four Rift Shards.

quests.title: Metal Without a Name
quests.subtitle: Grey, light and very far from home.
description: &6Titanium Ore&r lies deep (below Y 16) and wants an iron pickaxe; the ore only breaks for an Ashborn of &6RPG level 10&r or more. Rift Caches drop the ingots too.
Titanium is the Fabricator's favourite metal. Almost everything it prints wants some.
&7Smelt eight Titanium Ingots.

quests.title: &bThe Fabricator
quests.subtitle: It prints tomorrow, one hologram at a time.
description: &6The Keeper&r
&f&o"It makes things out of light. The Crown's forges did that once. I did not think anyone else remembered how."&r
Two titanium, a crafting table, redstone, a Block of Scrap and three scrap make a &6Fabricator&r. It knows twenty recipes: flux cells, boards, processors, every device, robot, chip and card.

Pick a recipe to see what you have and what you need. &6Fabricate&r takes the parts from your inventory, and the item prints into the output slot while its hologram turns above the block. Hoppers can take the output.
&7Build a Fabricator.

quests.title: Copper Wiring
quests.subtitle: Green boards, gold veins.
description: At a crafting table: &6Copper Wiring&r (two copper and a redstone make three) and &6Blank Circuit Boards&r (an iron ingot, green dye and a scrap make two). In the Fabricator, a blank board, two wiring and three gold nuggets print a &6Circuit Board&r.
&7Print two Circuit Boards.

quests.title: Cobalt
quests.subtitle: Blue metal from the bottom of the world.
description: &6Cobalt Ore&r lies below Y -16, wants an iron pickaxe, and only breaks for an Ashborn of &6RPG level 20&r. Rift Caches drop the ingots now and then.
Everything that holds &bFlux&r is made of it: the Flux Charger and every Flux Cell.
&7Smelt eight Cobalt Ingots.

quests.title: Tomorrow's Steel
quests.subtitle: Four metals, four tiers, one future.
description: The rift metals make tools and armour at four tiers: &6scrap&r (between stone and iron), &6titanium&r (iron), &6cobalt&r (diamond) and &6orichalcum&r (between diamond and netherite). Each asks for its points on the K screen: cobalt wants 14 Attack Power for tools, 14 Protection for armour.
A &6Cobalt Pickaxe&r mines whatever a diamond one does, without a Duskforged Ingot in the handle.
&7Make a Cobalt Pickaxe and a Cobalt Chestplate.

quests.title: &bFlux
quests.subtitle: Power without a single cable.
description: Every device from the rifts runs on &bFlux&r. A &6Flux Charger&r (four titanium, three cobalt, a furnace and a block of redstone) burns any furnace fuel (coal: 6,400 Flux) or a Rift Shard (40,000) and holds 100,000. Without a cable it beams the charge to the device in its slot, to the gear of anyone within 4 blocks, and to drones, mechs and skiffs within 8. A printed &6Flux Cell&r (two cobalt, four redstone, a wiring) tops up a robot or vehicle by hand.
&o"Same coal, same hunger as the generator in the Works. No cables. I hate it. Leave it on."&r &7— the Smith Under Ash&r
&7Build a Flux Charger and print two Flux Cells.

quests.title: A Mind in Quartz
quests.subtitle: Everything that moves needs one.
description: Two Circuit Boards, a Rift Shard and two quartz print a &6Processor&r. Every drone, mech, skiff and weapon from the rifts thinks with one.
Quartz comes from the Ashlands, or out of diorite through Create's crushing wheels. A Rift Cache sometimes holds a whole Processor.
&7Print a Processor.

quests.title: A Small, Loyal Light
quests.subtitle: It follows you. Nothing else from tomorrow does.
description: Six scrap, a Flux Cell, a Processor and a Circuit Board print a &6Drone&r. Use it on a block to deploy it; it follows whoever set it down. Sneak-use an empty hand on it to pack it up again.
&7Print a Drone.

quests.title: Chips
quests.subtitle: Teach it a trade.
description: A &6Blank Card&r (paper, an iron nugget, redstone) and a Circuit Board make every chip. Install one by using it on your drone.

&6Collector Chip&r (and a hopper): brings items lying within 10 blocks to you. &6Guard Chip&r (and a Rift Shard): shoots hostile mobs near you. &6Lamp Chip&r (and four glowstone dust): lights the way.
&7Print all three chips.

quests.title: Light That Cuts
quests.subtitle: Weapons from a war that never started.
description: The &6Plasma Cutter&r (titanium, a Flux Cell, a Processor, two Rift Shards and a diamond): hold use to cut the block you look at, up to 12 blocks away, as fast as a diamond tool. The &6Pulse Rifle&r (titanium, a Flux Cell, a Processor, two Rift Shards): a laser bolt every half second, 7 damage each. It wants 10 Attack Speed.
&o"A crossbow that never needs bolts. The Company will want six."&r &7— Maren, Captain of the Ashen Company&r
&7Print a Plasma Cutter and a Pulse Rifle.

quests.title: Walking Iron
quests.subtitle: Tomorrow's knights rode these.
description: Four Blocks of Scrap, eight titanium, three Flux Cells, a Processor and two pistons print a &6Mech&r. Use it on a block to deploy it, right-click to climb in. It steps up blocks, leaps while you hold jump and &6slams&r the ground where it lands (8 damage and knockback all around). Its rider hits harder.
&7Driving one wants 20 Fortitude. Print a Mech.

quests.title: Upgrade Cards
quests.subtitle: Fixed bonuses, fixed limits.
description: Every card is a Blank Card printed with one more thing; use it on your mech. &6Bulk&r (a golden apple): +10 health. &6Damage&r (four blaze powder): +2 damage for its rider. &6Defense&r (four titanium): +4 armour. Five of each at most. &6Speed&r (sugar and redstone): +10% speed, three at most. A &6Repair Card&r (two iron, four scrap) mends 20 health.
&7Print a Bulk, a Defense and a Repair Card.

quests.title: &bA Seat Above the Ash
quests.subtitle: Only the phantoms fly now. Not for much longer.
description: &6The Keeper&r
&f&o"Nothing has flown over Last Light since the sun went out but the phantoms. Go and show them they are not alone up there."&r

Ten titanium, four Flux Cells, a Processor, four Rift Shards and two phantom membranes print a &6Hover Skiff&r: a one-seat craft that banks into its turns. Use it on a block to deploy. W and S for speed, look to steer, jump to climb, sprint to descend; the screen shows Flux, speed and height. About four minutes of flight a charge, so park it by a Flux Charger.
Phantoms find anyone who has not slept in three nights. Their membranes are the only part of them worth keeping.
&7Print a Hover Skiff.

quests.title: Fire on Your Back
quests.subtitle: Seventy-five seconds of not touching the ground.
description: Six titanium, two Flux Cells, a Processor and two &6blaze rods&r from the Ashlands' fortresses print a &6Jetpack&r. Wear it and hold jump to fly: about seventy-five seconds of thrust, and no fall damage while it has charge. A Flux Charger refills it while you stand close.
&7It wants 10 Agility. Print a Jetpack.

quests.title: Orichalcum
quests.subtitle: The deepest metal, the furthest future.
description: &6Orichalcum Ore&r lies at the bottom of the world (Y -64 to -40). It wants a diamond-tier pickaxe (a Cobalt Pickaxe will do) and an Ashborn of &6RPG level 32&r. Rift Caches drop an ingot now and then.
Rift Gates and the Rift Beacon are built on it.
&7Smelt six Orichalcum Ingots.

quests.title: Rift Gates
quests.subtitle: Two seconds, any distance.
description: Eight black stained glass around a Rift Shard make eight &6Rift Glass&r. Four Rift Glass, two orichalcum, two ender pearls and two Rift Shards print a &6Rift Gate&r; two titanium, a shard and a compass print the &6Rift Tuner&r. Use the tuner on two gates to link them. Stand on one for two seconds and you step out of the other.
&o"Every road in this world was earned at a shrine. These earn nothing. Earn the orichalcum, then."&r &7— the Keeper&r
&7Make eight Rift Glass, print two Rift Gates and a Rift Tuner.

quests.title: A Gate Under the Black Sun
quests.subtitle: A door from a future into a past that won't end.
description: Rift Gates don't care how far apart they stand, or in which world. Set one at Last Light, carry its twin into the &5Eclipsed Realm&r and link them with the tuner: the black sun is two seconds from your bed.
&o"A door from a morning that never came into a night that never ends. I don't like it. Use it anyway."&r &7— the Keeper&r
&7Print another pair of gates and link one into the Eclipsed Realm.

tasks.title: One of my gates stands in the Eclipsed Realm

quests.title: &bCall the Sky Down
quests.subtitle: The hole where the sun was, answering when you knock.
description: &6The Keeper&r

&f&o"When the sun went out, the hole it left had to lead somewhere. Now we know: into a tomorrow that was never going to happen, and tomorrow fell. Call it down if you must, Ashborn. Only remember it was never meant for us."&r

Four Rift Glass, four orichalcum, a Processor and four Rift Shards print a &6Rift Beacon&r. Use four more shards on it and it calls a Chrono Pod down beside itself, Sentinels and all, when you choose instead of when the sky does.
&7Print a Rift Beacon, call a rift down and destroy the Sentinels that come with it.
